## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.6

### 新功能

- **键鼠照常用（Mac mini 模式）**：在「设置 › 息屏 › 显示器」选「只关所选」并打开「键鼠照常用」，可以只关 MacBook 内建屏，外接屏照常亮着，本机键盘、鼠标、触控板照常使用，光标不会移进关掉的屏。按住唤醒快捷键、紧急快捷键、菜单栏或计划结束时恢复。这个模式下不会关闭外接屏，也不关键盘背光。Windows 上同样可用。
- **Mac 内建屏真正断开**：有其他显示器亮着时，内建屏会像合盖一样断开，面板断电，适合 OLED。需要 Apple 芯片和 macOS 13 及以上；其他情况仍把背光调到 0 并盖黑色遮罩。可在「设置 › 息屏 › 内建屏」里选择「自动 / 断开 / 只关背光」，「自动」在 M3 系列和 iMac 上不断开。
- **自动接回内建屏**：唤醒、按紧急快捷键、退出、程序异常退出后重新打开，或者息屏中拔掉外接屏（3 秒内）时，都会把内建屏接回来。内建屏是唯一的显示器时不会断开。

### 注意

- 断开内建屏时，上面的窗口会移到外接屏，macOS 可能重新调整外接屏的排列或分辨率，唤醒后恢复。
- 如果黑着跑被强制结束且没有重新打开，合上再打开盖子、注销或重启都能让内建屏恢复。

更新方式：已安装 0.1.1 及以上版本时，在「设置 › 关于与诊断」里点「更新并重启」，或等每日检查自动提示。

## BlankRun · 黑着跑 0.1.6

### New

- **Keep using keyboard & mouse ("Mac mini mode")**: in Settings › Screen Off › Displays, choose "Selected only" and turn on "Keep using keyboard & mouse" to turn off just the MacBook's built-in screen. The external display stays on, the local keyboard, mouse and trackpad keep working, and the cursor stays off the dark screen. The wake shortcut (held), the emergency shortcut, the menu bar or the end of the schedule bring it back. The external display and the keyboard backlight are never turned off in this mode. Works on Windows too.
- **Mac built-in display truly disconnected**: while another display is on, the built-in display is disconnected the way closing the lid does it, so the panel is powered down (good for OLED). Requires Apple silicon and macOS 13 or later; otherwise the backlight still goes to 0 under a black overlay. Choose Automatic, Disconnect or Backlight off only in Settings › Screen Off › Built-in display. Automatic doesn't disconnect on M3-family Macs or iMacs.
- **Built-in display always comes back**: it's reconnected on wake, on the emergency shortcut, on quit, on the next launch after an abnormal exit, and within 3 seconds if the external display is unplugged while blanked. It's never disconnected when it's the only display.

### Notes

- When the built-in display is disconnected, its windows move to the external display and macOS may rearrange or change the resolution of the external display until wake.
- If BlankRun is force-quit and not reopened, closing and opening the lid, logging out or restarting brings the built-in display back.

To update from 0.1.1 or later, click "Update and restart" in Settings › About & Diagnostics, or wait for the daily check.
